args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after its latest deploy, with an error rate of 18%. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback health checks confirm the service is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 regression before re-deploying.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** All regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that previously showed healthy in production (v2.3.1's prior release).
3. **Verified:** Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** SEV2 incident **INC-0001** was created for checkout-api, documenting the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged. Follow-up recommended: determine the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.
